violation_type.title: Household Members Qualifications - Left in Charge must meet qualifications and training for caregivers (26 TAC §747.1401(c))
violation_type.short_title: Household Members Qualifications - Left in Charge must meet qualifications and training for caregivers
violation_type.typical_finding: Caregiver left in charge of care at the operation has not completed orientation.

finding_variants.text: Caregiver left in charge of care at the operation has not completed orientation.
During the course of the investigation, it was noted that the permit holder left household member in charge of children that does not meet minimum qualifications.
A volunteer was left in charge of the group, that does not have the trainings to meet substitute qualifications.
A household member who does not have substitute caregiver qualifications was left in charge of the home while the primary caregiver was away from the home.
The operation's household members are left in charge of the operation, but do not have a background check ran under the role of caregiver.
